title: Robotic learning identifies nine polyoxometalate-based frameworks
summary: A robot and an XGBoost classifier guided crystallization experiments that produced nine reported polyoxometalate-scaffolding metal-organic frameworks. Researchers defined the chemistry and performed structural and electrochemical characterization. The measured electron-transfer behavior does not establish practical energy-storage deployment.

evidence.tested: Nine frameworks were synthesized with reported repeatability.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication, exhaustive structural prior art and device performance were not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: XGBoost with uncertainty-feedback retraining supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.

source_review.scope: Institutional publication record and primary abstract; full paper and supplements not reread.
